Description: Freeware Advanced Audio Coder FAAC is an open-source, dependency-free AAC encoder aimed at embedded and pipeline use cases where footprint and throughput matter as much as quality. . Key features: . - MPEG-4 AAC-LC and HE-AAC v1 (SBR) profiles - Sample rates from 8 kHz to 96 kHz, supporting mono up to 5.1 multichannel - VBR and ABR rate control with a bit reservoir - Advanced encoding tools: Dynamic block-switching, PNS, and TNS - Flexible output options: Raw ADTS, ADIF bitstream
Package-List: faac deb sound optional arch=any libfaac-dev deb libdevel optional arch=any libfaac1 deb libs optional arch=any
